$comment: Secret-free, reproducible description of the Ultra Grok Bot account. No tokens, no account ids. Seats and holders come from docs/agents/constitution/roster.md; descriptions from docs/agents/grok-bots/. Decided 2026-11-05 (Matthew Cheek). Rev 2026-11-05 r2: Codex P2 fixes (R1 quoted scope, R4 canonical tag, R5 self-exclusion + idempotency).

routines.filter: body contains '[PRECHECK] #' and 'READY', or '[YES] #' and 'scope: "merge"' (quoted, the canonical Relay form)

routines.action: triage; claim only if released or assigned; else [CI] FAIL -> holder

routines.filter: changes_requested on an Ultra PR, or '[YES] #' naming an edit
body contains '[SLICE] #' and '-> Ultra Builder n' (canonical form: [SLICE] #N @<40-hex> -> Ultra Builder n)

comment author is not verdant-ultra-bot, and body contains any of [WITHDRAWN] [FALLBACK released_by: claimed_by: 'READY FOR REVIEW' BLOCKED on an Ultra PR; [HANDOFF] is excluded (it is the Relay's own receipt)
routines.action: reconcile handoff file; post [HANDOFF] CURRENT|STALE only when the recorded state differs from the last [HANDOFF] on that PR (idempotent); never on an unchanged state
reconciliation pass; summary; WAITING ON MATTHEW line

deny: git rebase of a pushed branch
requireApproval: create or edit a routine or trigger
launch a cloud agent in a mode other than verdant-builder

yesAuthorAllowlist.note: Steward BLOCKs a [YES] from any other author. Full fix: an owner-only identity no bot holds (open decision).
